archival_memory.appliance_price: The coffee grinder is priced at $299, while the storage canister is $39. Both are available for pre-order now.
archival_memory.shipping_info: The appliances will be shipped within 2-3 weeks of the pre-order date. You will receive a confirmation email with tracking information once the shipment is on its way.
archival_memory.warranty_info: Both the coffee grinder and storage canister come with a standard warranty that covers any defects or malfunctions for one year from the date of purchase.
